name: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai

quotes.quote: Who cares about reading the atmosphere. It's ridiculous!
I don't mind if I only had one person. Even if the whole world hated me, I could keep living if that person needed me.
If you keep running away from reality, you'll never catch up to it.
People who like you will like you no matter what you do.
Your scars are proof that you've lived.
